newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LIONS WARNED TO PREPARE FOR MATCH OF LIVES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS WARNED TO PREPARE FOR MATCH OF LIVES.

text.p: Coach Ian McGeechan has told his players to prepare themselves for the match of their lives when the British Lions meet South Africa in Cape Town on Saturday in the first match of their three-test series.
The Lions have looked increasingly impressive in winning seven out of eight matches to date but will have to raise their game for the Home Unions' first meeting with the Springboks in 17 years.
